shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "ls -la && printf '\\n--- package.json ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- tracked files ---\\n' && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | head -200 && printf '\\n--- instructions ---\\n' && find .. -name AGENTS.md -print"
/bin/bash -c 'npm install next react react-dom && npm install -D typescript @types/node @types/react'
/bin/bash -c "mkdir -p app/api/books/'[id]' app/books/'[id]' lib data && touch data/books.json && printf '[]\\n' > data/books.json"

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: tsconfig.json
@@
-    \"baseUrl\": \".\",
     \"paths\": { \"@/*\": [\"./*\"] },
*** End Patch
PATCH
npm run build"
/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,100p' tsconfig.json && sed -n '55,125p' app/book-dashboard.tsx && git diff --stat && git diff -- package.json .gitignore README.md"

/bin/bash -c 'set -euo pipefail
initial=$(curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/api/books)
test "$initial" = '"'[]'
created="'$(curl -fsS -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/books -H '"'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"title\":\"Smoke Test Book\",\"author\":\"Sample Author\",\"notes\":\"A useful note.\"}')
id="'$(printf '"'%s' \""'$created" | node -e '"'let data=\"\";process.stdin.on(\"data\", chunk => data += chunk);process.stdin.on(\"end\", () => process.stdout.write(JSON.parse(data).id))')
curl -fsS \"http://localhost:3000/books/"'$id" | rg -q '"'Smoke Test Book'
finished="'$(curl -fsS -X PATCH "http://localhost:3000/api/books/$id")
printf '"'%s' \""'$finished" | rg -q '"'\"status\":\"finished\"'
printf 'API smoke test passed for book %s\\n' \""'$id"'

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: data/books.json
@@
-  {
-    \"id\": \"13662fb1-af16-4648-b08c-d356bf166541\",
-    \"title\": \"Smoke Test Book\",
-    \"author\": \"Sample Author\",
-    \"notes\": \"A useful note.\",
-    \"status\": \"finished\",
-    \"addedAt\": \"2026-09-22T20:16:06.323Z\",
-    \"finishedAt\": \"2026-09-22T20:16:06.523Z\"
-  }
+  
*** End Patch
PATCH
printf '[]\\n' > /tmp/books-empty.json
"

/bin/bash -c "git diff --check && git status --short && printf '\\n--- persisted data ---\\n' && cat data/books.json && printf '\\n--- package scripts ---\\n' && node -e 'console.log(JSON.stringify(require(\"./package.json\").scripts))'"

/bin/bash -c "rg -n 'export async function getBooks|export async function addBook|export async function finishBook|export default async function HomePage|export function BookDashboard|export default async function BookPage|export function ShareButton|Run locally|JSON-file storage|export async function POST|export async function PATCH' lib/books.ts app/page.tsx app/book-dashboard.tsx 'app/books/[id]/page.tsx' 'app/books/[id]/share-button.tsx' app/api/books/route.ts 'app/api/books/[id]/route.ts' README.md"
